config.rng_order: random.Random(42): randint(0, 256) per sorted feature, then sample
config.sort_key: assembly, seqid, first1, strand, feature_type, feature_id

controls.mechanism: matched control: the unspliced survivor host must pass both Pin 1 rules
controls.name: pin1_control_host_is_clean

controls.mechanism: a 200-nt segment of fold_contexts, spliced into a Pin-1-clean survivor at phase 300: rule 1 fires and the attribution contains fold_contexts
controls.name: pin1_kmer_fold_contexts

controls.mechanism: the same segment is carried by fold_contexts alone, so the attribution is exactly that source
controls.name: pin1_kmer_exclusive_fold_contexts

controls.mechanism: a 200-nt segment of mined_windows, spliced into a Pin-1-clean survivor at phase 300: rule 1 fires and the attribution contains mined_windows
controls.name: pin1_kmer_mined_windows

controls.mechanism: a 200-nt segment of decoy_inserts, spliced into a Pin-1-clean survivor at phase 300: rule 1 fires and the attribution contains decoy_inserts
controls.name: pin1_kmer_decoy_inserts

controls.mechanism: the same segment is carried by decoy_inserts alone, so the attribution is exactly that source
controls.name: pin1_kmer_exclusive_decoy_inserts

controls.mechanism: a 200-nt segment of stage2_population, spliced into a Pin-1-clean survivor at phase 300: rule 1 fires and the attribution contains stage2_population
controls.name: pin1_kmer_stage2_population

controls.mechanism: the coordinate-only v1 host (A15 Pin 1): rule 2 fires, rule 1 does not
controls.name: pin1_coordinate_only

controls.mechanism: the same candidate's coordinates under accession 'CP003056.1'
controls.name: pin1_accession_as_given
controls.note: masking.normalize_accession strips the INSDC .N version on both sides

controls.mechanism: the same candidate's coordinates under accession 'CP003056'
controls.name: pin1_accession_stripped
controls.note: masking.normalize_accession strips the INSDC .N version on both sides

controls.mechanism: content screen (A15 Pin 2): a catalogued RF00230 T-box spliced into the clean control host
controls.name: content_rf00230_master

controls.mechanism: the same host, unspliced, must be admitted (the matched control)
controls.name: content_host_unspliced

screened_dna.alphabet_rule: upper-case, U->T; any k-mer containing a non-ACGT character is skipped, on both sides
screened_dna.rule_1: the WHOLE pre-splice window's canonical (both-strand) 32-mers against the union of the four sources
screened_dna.rule_2: same-accession overlap with a training interval, accession-version-normalised, strand-folded, closed bounds

decoy_inserts.over_approximates: every decoys_v0 insert, including the gc_background and leader_decoy pools A7 kept out of both training mixes — not a training-exposure claim (A15 Pin 1 iii)

mined_windows.interval_rule: mining_pool_v0 [locus_start, locus_end] — the WINDOW's own genomic interval, not its parent locus's (mining/pool.py::carve_window writes forward_bounds of the carved window)

stage2_population.predicate: fold_random == "train" AND NOT calib AND (nested_train true OR nested_role null) — read through stage2.train.select_rows(rung='train', admit_parentless_decoys=True)

selection: ADR-0005 A17: native §9.1 class-4 leaders (CDS-upstream + tRNA-upstream 1,024-nt windows, δ ~ U{0..256}) on the 339 annotated admissible a2 hosts; seed-42 uniform draw; A15 Pin 1 + Pin 2 screens unchanged; D4-context windows beside the graded set
